messages:
Ari Gomez: quick brainstorm 10m planning a microlaunch next Thurs: timed social posts + a short 'how-to' webinar + 100 free tokens for first-run. objective = increase 24h activation by 6pt. anyone see issues?

Noah Kim: love it. whats our audience slice? new signups last 30d or broader inbound?

Ari Gomez: new signups last 30d who haven't run a prompt (about 6.5k). we'll sample 4k for the experiment, 1k control.

Rae Thompson: copy note  let's test two angles: "Jumpstart with ready prompts" vs "Try with free tokens". keep CTAs explicit: "Run your first prompt" not just "Explore".

Ivy Chen: logistics: I'll set the RSVP flow so attendees get an auto-email with a direct "Run Starter Prompt" button that calls /start?template=starter_A. we'll randomize A/B/C templates.

Noah Kim: routing: prioritize users with product events "visited_playground" in last 7d. fallback to email drip for others. if webinar fills, provide on-demand link + starter template pack.

Rae Thompson: tracking checklist: add experiment_id=plg_microlaunch_2026 and events: signup_experiment, webinar_rsvp, email_click, prompt_run. Ivy can you add UTM as well?

Ivy Chen: done. UTM pattern: utm_source=profile_post&utm_campaign=microlaunch&utm_term={variant}. also feature-flagging: @ops-bot can we gate the nudge behind flag plg_micro_nudge_v1?

ops-bot: feature-flag created: plg_micro_nudge_v1. rollout policy: 0% -> 50% after 12h -> 100% after 36h. auto-rollback if error-rate > 1.5%.

Sam Ortiz: I'll draft 4 short social headers and 2 email subject lines by EOD tomorrow. planning to include a TL;DR GIF showing "one-click run".

Ari Gomez: perfect. sync tomorrow 9:30 to finalize cohorts and go/no-go. keep copy punchy and product-action oriented. :sparkles:
